idea: Implement a simple TF-IDF-inspired weighting system: For each document in the pool, calculate its average Jaccard similarity to each document in the target_sample. Select the top 20% of documents based on this score, then from that subset, select documents whose token lengths are closest to the target_sample average.
why: Combining content relevance (Jaccard) with document uniqueness can filter out low-quality noise and repetitive junk while keeping content that matches the domain's distribution.
